proposals.title: Sustainability Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board issue an annual independently verified stand-alone Sustainability Report describing short- and long-term responses to ESG-related issues, with statistical indicators and goals, available to shareholders by June 1, 2016.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE "AGAINST" THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a proxy access bylaw allowing shareholders owning 3% of stock for three years to nominate directors included in company proxy materials, up to one quarter of the board or two.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE "AGAINST" THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
